_quoi: LA DETTE QUE LA PASSE RÉPARÉE A RÉVÉLÉE. Tant que l'outil d'inventaire était pris pour un navigateur automatisé, le serveur bloquait son adresse et TOUT ce qu'une route sert s'inventoriait sur « Chargement… » : six modules servaient donc du français que le catalogue ne voyait pas, et que personne ne pouvait donc traduire. Ce fichier le traduit — les quatre écrans de la diligence OCDE pour l'essentiel, puis les littéraux du JavaScript, la coquille, carto, finops, le registre. LES INTITULÉS DE L'OCDE SONT CEUX DE SA VERSION ANGLAISE : les six étapes et les options de réparation reprennent la terminologie du OECD Due Diligence Guidance (embed, identify and assess, cease prevent and mitigate, track, communicate, remediation), pas une traduction libre du français.

texte.Chaque point tourne entre « tenu », « pa: Each point cycles between 'met', 'partial', 'not met' and 'not applicable'. 'Not applicable' takes the point out of the calculation instead of counting zero: a point your capacity does not cover is not a failure.
texte.Confondre « rien de déclaré » et « hors: Confusing 'nothing declared' with 'out of scope': the first returns no rate, the second returns 'not applicable' — and only the second is an answer.
Confusing 'nothing declared' with 'out of scope'. The first is a question with no answer and returns no rate; the second is an answer, and the rate card says 'not applicable'.
texte.Croire ce chapitre exposé au plafond du: Believing this Chapter exposed to the GDPR cap: Article #(#) designates only Chapters II, III and V, and for VI the regime is national.
texte.Croire que ce chapitre expose au plafond: Believing that this Chapter exposes you to the GDPR cap. Article #(#) designates only Chapters II, III and V: for VI the regime is national, and no European cap applies.
texte.Croire que l'accès du chapitre II rempla: Believing that Chapter II access replaces Articles # and # GDPR: Article #(#) says it COMPLEMENTS them, and answering one does not discharge the other.
Believing that Chapter II access replaces Articles # and # GDPR. Article #(#) says it COMPLEMENTS them: two rights, two regimes, and answering one does not discharge the other.
texte.Croire que l'échéance de l'article # se: Believing that the Article # deadline can be caught up on: it passed on # September #, and an intermediary predating # June # that has not notified is in breach, not behind.

Believing that the Article # deadline can be caught up on. A provider already supplying the service on # June # had to notify by # September # at the latest: that date has passed, and the breach is made out.

texte.Déclarez votre qualité au titre du règle: Declare your capacity under Regulation (EU) #/#, or tick 'none of these capacities' — which is a complete answer and closes this path.
texte.Elle ne confond pas « rien de déclaré »: It does not confuse 'nothing declared' with 'out of scope'. The first is a question with no answer: the rate card returns « — ». The second is an answer: it returns 'not applicable'. The two look alike on screen and say nothing like the same thing.

texte.Elle ne traite pas l’exemption comme un: It does not treat the exemption as a general out-of-scope. The unfair terms of Chapter IV, the switching of Chapter VI and the international access of Chapter VII know nothing of it.
texte.Elle ne vous dit pas si votre migration: It does not tell you whether your migration is technically feasible. Article #(#) requires the provider to publish the services for which switching is highly complex, costly or impossible without significant interference: that answer is read at the provider, not here.

texte.Le règlement n'établit que quatre cadres: The Regulation establishes only four frameworks, and only three of them create obligations. Knowing in two clicks that you fall under none of them is worth more than a rate invented for a project that does not exist.
texte.Le taux peut être élevé et le manquement: The rate can be high and the breach still made out: the notification cannot be caught up on, it is made.
texte.Le texte répète « quel que soit le lieu: The text repeats 'whatever the place of establishment' for the manufacturer, the data holder and the cloud provider. A company outside the Union that places a connected product on the Union market, or that serves customers in the Union, is bound. This is the most frequent misreading.

texte.Les deux règlements entrent dans l'indic: The two Regulations enter the index like the other fourteen: an index that measured fourteen of them and ignored two applicable Regulations would announce a false figure.
texte.Les micro et petites entreprises sont ex: Micro and small enterprises are exempt from Chapter II — and from Chapter II ONLY — on two conditions: having no partner or linked enterprise that is not itself micro or small, and not working as a subcontractor to manufacture or design a connected product. Declaring 'small enterprise' is therefore not enough, and the page does not grant it without both answers.

texte.Lire « sans préjudice » comme « sans rap: Reading 'without prejudice' as 'unrelated': the opposite holds, and your record of processing activities is not suspended.
Reading 'without prejudice' as 'unrelated'. The opposite holds: the GDPR applies to ALL personal data processed in connection with the Regulation, and it prevails in the event of a conflict.

texte.L’article # §# : quand l’utilisateur n’e: Article #(#): where the user is not the data subject, personal data is made available to them only where there is a valid legal basis under Article # GDPR and, where applicable, where the conditions of Article # GDPR and of Article #(#) of Directive #/#/EC are met. Without Article #, the request is refused.
texte.L’article # §# donne compétence aux auto: Article #(#) gives the GDPR supervisory authorities — the CNIL — competence over infringements of Chapters II, III and V, up to the amount in Article #(#): EUR # # # or # % of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher. And Article #(#) provides for NO reduction for SMEs, whereas Article #(#) of the AI Act retains the lower cap for them: an SME is therefore more exposed here than under the AI Act.
texte.L’article # §# ne désigne que les chapit: Article #(#) designates only Chapters II, III and V. For Chapter VI, the penalty regime is the one the Member State lays down, and no European cap applies. The page says so to avoid the opposite error: believing exposure is at its maximum where it is in fact national.
texte.L’article # §# supprime tout frais de ch: Article #(#) withdraws all switching charges on # January #. Until then, reduced charges remain allowed, capped at the costs directly related to the process, and the pre-contractual information of §# is due: standard service fees, early-termination penalties, applicable reduced charges.
texte.L’article #er §# le dit en propres terme: Article #(#) says it in so many words: in so far as the users are the data subjects, the Chapter II rights complement the rights of access and portability of Articles # and # GDPR. Two rights, two regimes, two deadlines — and answering under one does not discharge a request under the other.
